hypothesis: At the pinned 9a4caa7b defaults (592.9M params, ~2071-2076 optimizer steps in 1800 s), maintaining an EMA of the weights over the last 25% of the budget (decay 0.995, ~518-519 tail updates) and evaluating that EMA state will lower public_val_bpb relative to the raw final weights and relative to the same-host control. Mechanism (hypothesis, not established): late-training weight averaging reduces iterate noise in the low-LR tail; the only prior negative EMA result was a 400-second run with 474 steps and only 103 EMA-tail updates, where 0.995^103 ~= 0.60 of the EMA mass still sat on the snapshot taken at EMA start; at full budget the residual snapshot weight is 0.995^519 ~= 0.07, so averaging lag no longer dominates. Per train.py:293-309 and 6218-6233 the only behavioral delta is that EMA shadow weights are maintained after 75% of the budget, saved alongside the raw weights, and used as the preferred evaluation state when present. This is a corrected resubmission of the never-run NEEDS_WORK proposals 20260922-weight-ema-default-shape and 20260922-weight-ema-fullbudget-r2 that fixes each cited defect: (a) historical evidence corrected to 474 steps / 103 EMA-tail updates; (b) averaging lag is stated as a hypothesis; (c) outcome classes are mutually exclusive with explicit precedence and the paired EMA-vs-raw comparison is primary. Pre-full check: the candidate's resolved weight_ema oneliner must show weight_ema=True and, at run end, updates>0 while controls show False/0; otherwise FALSIFIED-INERT without a full run. Definitions: S = candidate steps; C = same-host control public_val_bpb (trn21 1.005734 @ 2071 steps; trn22 1.005967 @ 2076 steps); E = candidate public_val_bpb (EMA-evaluated state); R = candidate raw-weight public_val_bpb if the run logs it. Outcome classes, mutually exclusive, evaluated in order, first match wins: (1) CONFOUNDED-SHORT if S < 0.90 x same-host control steps (experiment-protocol.md section 5; record as throughput regression only). (2) FALSIFIED-INERT if the final weight_ema oneliner shows weight_ema=False or updates=0, or the evaluated state is not the EMA state. (3) FALSIFIED-MECHANISM if R is logged and E >= R (EMA did not beat its own paired raw weights; this takes precedence over any control comparison). (4) SUCCESS if (R not logged or E < R) and E <= C - 0.001. (5) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if E >= C (EMA beat raw or R unavailable, but the run did not beat control, e.g. EMA update overhead cost steps). (6) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (C - 0.001 < E < C, within the observed ~0.0002-0.0003 control noise band). Trajectory/numerical-equivalence claims are not made from the fixed-budget result; step count is recorded separately as an overhead measurement (EMA overhead annotation if S < 0.97 x control steps).
